Subject: Re: Fwd: Order form details and VAT handling — legal + tax guidance

Thanks for the ping. Quick notes from legal/billing perspective: 

- Invoicing entity: Recommend US entity (Redwood Inference, Inc.) on the order form for initial contract to simplify Nova's accounting and payment routing. If Nova requires an EU entity invoicing route we can invoice from Redwood B.V. but that requires VAT registration evidence and a W-8/other tax docs — that'll add 7–10 business days to onboarding.

- VAT / reverse-charge: For EU subsidiaries that are VAT-registered, include a standard EU reverse-charge clause in Appendix B. Suggested wording included in the redline (see page 5 of Nova_OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf). If they are not VAT-registered we'll charge local VAT and need to collect VAT ID / tax residency.

- Net terms: Net 30 is our standard for new logos. Net 45 is a commercial concession; Finance needs a one-time approval. If we agree Net 45, propose: Net 45 with a 2% early-pay discount for Net 30 to bridge. Finance can approve if ARR >= $250k and there's a signed SOW/order.

- Invoice cadence: operational trade-off: monthly invoicing aligns with usage and reduces true-up complexity; quarterly invoices are simpler for enterprise AP but increase forecast variance. Recommend monthly for the first 90 days (to validate consumption patterns) then transition to quarterly if they prefer. Call out activation/proration: first invoice upon signature covering the activation fee + prorated monthly usage to month end.

I'll paste the exact suggested clause below and am attaching a short redline snippet for the VAT clause. LMK if you want me to send this directly to Nova or have sales own it.

Suggested EU reverse-charge clause (short form):
"Where Customer is a taxable person in the EU and provides Redwood with a valid VAT identification number, VAT shall be accounted for under the reverse charge mechanism and Customer shall be liable for any VAT due. Where Customer fails to provide a valid VAT identification number, Redwood shall charge applicable VAT and Customer shall remit VAT to Redwood."

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@novacorp.com>, procurement@novacorp.com

Date: 2025-07-14T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed execution checklist & commercial positions (see attached)

Hi Lisa — and thanks for the clarity. Per procurement's request we've consolidated our proposed positions below so you can take them back to your AP/legal team. If you agree, we'll prepare a final order form (v4) and route via DocuSign.

Key commercial positions (Redwood proposal):
1) Invoicing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US entity) as primary invoice issuer. If Nova requires EU invoicing, we'll switch to Redwood B.V. and provide VAT registration documents prior to first invoice.
2) VAT: Include reverse-charge language for EU-registered subsidiaries (see suggested clause). If a Nova entity is not VAT-registered, Redwood will charge local VAT; Nova to provide VAT ID or confirm non-registered status before signature.
3) Net terms: Redwood standard Net 30. We can accept Net 45 subject to Finance approval. As a compromise, offer Net 45 with 2% early-pay discount if paid by Net 30 (Finance approval required for deals above $250k ARR).
4) Invoice cadence: First invoice upon signature (activation fee + prorated usage). Recommend monthly invoicing for first 90 days, then switch to quarterly if both parties prefer.
5) Minimum commit phasing: As discussed in the pricing schedule, first tranche to be billed at execution (50% of quarter 1 commit), remaining tranches billed at the start of each subsequent quarter. We included a sample tranche schedule in pricing_schedule_q3-q4_v2.xlsx.

Ask from Nova for smooth execution:
- Confirm invoicing entity to fill in the PO.
- Specify billing contact and AP system (for electronic invoices / EDI).
- Confirm VAT ID(s) for any EU entities that will be in scope.

If this looks good I will: (a) ask Finance for Net 45 exception for this deal, (b) prepare the order form v4 with agreed language and (c) send DocuSign routing.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Principal Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.com

Attachments: Nova_OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf (PDF), pricing_schedule_q3-q4_v2.xlsx (XLSX)
